responsibility: Declares gcc_rich_location, GCC’s extension wrapper around libcpp rich_location for tree-aware diagnostics. It provides helpers for adding expression ranges and formatted fix-its, declares label classes for text and type-mismatch annotations, and defines binary_op_rich_location for diagnostics that want operand/operator highlighting, making this the compiler-facing companion to the generic locus-printing code.
same_name_distinction: Header for GCC-specific rich_location extensions: it defines the gcc_rich_location, label helper classes, and binary_op_rich_location interface, while gcc-rich-location.cc provides their tree-aware helper implementations and heuristics.
